claim_policy: This configuration exercises the paper's named visual architecture and augmentation families. It remains paper_protocol because the paper does not publish the 13-layer topology or augmentation parameters, the nU accounting is ambiguous, and validation-based loss-weight selection is not integrated.
known_gaps: The paper names a 13-layer CNN but does not publish its layer-by-layer topology; cnn13 is a documented clean-room adapter.
The paper names SimAugment and RandAugment but does not publish their parameters; crop, color, and RandAugment settings are explicit clean-room choices.
The paper reports nP=1000 and nU=50000 on a 50000-image CIFAR-10 training split. This disjoint runner uses 1000 P plus 49000 U and records the protocol difference.
The paper selects two loss weights on a separate clean 10% validation set. This fixed configuration uses 0.1 for both and does not claim paper-equivalent model selection.
The full 5-seed, 800-epoch CUDA experiment has not been executed.
